steps.title: Branch off main (e.g. feature/sub) — repo is on main and CLAUDE.md forbids committing there
In src/lib.rs, add `pub fn sub(a: i32, b: i32) -> i32 { a - b }` next to existing `add`
In the existing #[cfg(test)] mod in src/lib.rs, add a `subtracts` test (e.g. assert_eq!(sub(5, 3), 2)), then run `cargo test`
